title: Dual-Venue leg spec
description: A leg is defined ONCE and run by each venue whenever it is free (P1). legSpecSha256 in a receipt is the sha256 of this file's exact bytes, so editing a leg makes a new subject.

card.description: The card that declares this leg; venues.json roles are keyed by it.

clipId.description: A CONSENTED CLIP ID (never a path, never a tracked fixture: the fixtures are 2 and 16 frames and can never satisfy the owner's 20 s of real footage, so a fixture id is refused by the runner's admission gate, typed, and cannot even be written in a tracked leg). The runner also refuses a venue that has no owner-typed record for this id in venue-clip-consent.json.

playSeconds.description: The settled-playback window the job plays (generator -PlaySeconds). The owner's floor is 20 s; the clip must cover it and the run must advance that many distinct source frames, or the receipt is INVALID.

backends.description: Every playback leg runs as cuda AND cpu on EVERY venue (Amendment 1 A1). 'gl' is reserved and not yet runnable.

generatorArgs.description: Generator arguments other than -Venue/-Backend/-ScaleFactor/-SourceCommit/-BuildManifestSha256/-ClipId (the runner sets those).

look.description: Required when legType is 'look'. Look Assist is FORCED on for a look leg (Amendment 1 A2).

criteria.description: Per venue ROLE (P3) and per backend: criteria evaluated against the metrics copied verbatim from summary.json. An empty list is informational (no gating).
